// Standalone offline control, not a Go test root or a served reproduction.
package main

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"testing"
)

type privateError struct{ calls *int }

func (e privateError) Error() string {
	*e.calls++
	return "SECRET_FIXTURE_ONLY_NEVER_EXPORT"
}

func main() {
	const secret = "SECRET_FIXTURE_ONLY_NEVER_EXPORT"
	const leaf = "TestRunServeWhatsAppPublicLogoutBothStores/sqlite"
	calls := 0
	prose := privateError{&calls}
	rows := []struct {
		phase, site string
		flags       map[string]bool
		err         error
	}{
		{"inbox", "inbox_text_mismatch", map[string]bool{"text_equal": false, "message_operation_equal": true, "receipt_found": true, "receipt_reference_equal": true}, nil},
		{"inbox", "inbox_operation_mismatch", map[string]bool{"text_equal": true, "message_operation_equal": false}, nil},
		{"inbox", "receipt_missing", map[string]bool{"sent_candidate": true, "receipt_found": false, "receipt_reference_equal": false}, nil},
		{"inbox", "receipt_read_error", nil, prose},
		{"logout", "logout_replay", map[string]bool{"effect_equal": false, "revision_equal": true}, nil},
		{"logout", "logout_cli_exit", map[string]bool{"exit_zero": false}, context.DeadlineExceeded},
		{"logout", "logout_cli_token_file", nil, &os.PathError{Op: secret, Path: secret, Err: prose}},
	}
	for _, row := range rows {
		raw := nativeJourneyFailureJSON(leaf, "site", row.phase, row.site, secret, row.flags, row.err, false)
		if strings.Contains(raw, secret) {
			panic("formatter leaked private data")
		}
		var decoded map[string]any
		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(raw), &decoded); err != nil {
			panic("formatter did not produce JSON")
		}
		fmt.Println(raw)
	}
	fmt.Println(nativeJourneyFailureJSON(leaf, "phase", "inbox", "", "", nil, nil, true))
	if calls != 0 {
		panic("capture invoked Error")
	}
	scope, restore := nativeJourneyDiagnosticScope(&testing.T{}, "pairing")
	var workers sync.WaitGroup
	for n := 0; n < 2; n++ {
		workers.Go(func() {
			for range 100 {
				scope.mark("inbox")
				if scope.phase.Load().(string) != "inbox" {
					panic("phase read changed")
				}
			}
		})
	}
	workers.Wait()
	restore()
}
